  import type { SimpleQuote } from "./testimonials-simple.types";

    title,
    description = "",
    quotes,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    layout = "cards",
    cols = "3",

    : "items-start"
  );

  const grid = $derived(
